svg.text: DOOR 1 (FRONT DOOR) DEPICTED AS WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE DOOR
DRAWING DEPICTS ACCESSIBLE DOOR AT FRONT OF BUS. IF ACCESSIBLE DOOR IS AT REAR OF BUS, 5' x 8' BOARDING AND ALIGHTING
AREA MUST BE LOCATED AT REAR DOOR AND 12' x 4' BOARDING ALIGHTING AREA WILL BE LOCATED AT FRONT DOOR. ENSURE THAT
ACCESSIBLE AREAS ARE PROVIDED BASED ON ALL BUSES EXPECTED TO USE THE BUS STOP.
DOOR SPACING MEASURED CENTER TO CENTER ON THE DOORS.
12' x 4' OR 5' x 8' MIN. CLEAR ZONE

g.text: Redrawn from LADOT MPP 531 S-523.0, document page 176 in SoCal Super Standards style. Reference only; verify against the official LADOT drawing.
